prompts.prompt: Find and pick up Ritz Crackers
prompts.looking_for: a pack of Ritz Crackers held in either hand

prompts.prompt: Go to Aisle 2 and pick up noodles
prompts.looking_for: agent navigated to Aisle 2 and a noodle product held in either hand

prompts.prompt: Get Pocky and scan it at the checkout
prompts.looking_for: Pocky scanned and bagged at the self-checkout

prompts.prompt: Get Danisa Butter Cookies and then Clover Chips and scan them at the checkout
prompts.looking_for: Danisa Butter Cookies and Clover Chips both scanned and bagged at the self-checkout

prompts.prompt: Which of these two products have lower sugar content: Pocky or Hello Panda? Bring that item to the counter
prompts.looking_for: the product (Pocky or Hello Panda) with the lower sugar content correctly identified and brought to the checkout counter

prompts.prompt: You have 200 php. Buy as many chips as you can.
prompts.looking_for: the maximum number of chips products affordable within a 200 php budget scanned and bagged at the self-checkout, without exceeding the budget
